query_text: Recordings and notes are not available for me.
recommended_action: Confirm content is live; ask for a screenshot proactively rather than after a second complaint.

query_text: Enrolled in the AI course but hasn't received access to the Python course.
recommended_action: Never request passwords/credentials from users. Verify access via email lookup only. Clarify Python course rollout timeline.

query_text: Cannot continue learning; no further detail given.
recommended_action: Good practice already - just tighten grammar and request a screenshot.

query_text: Cannot continue AI course due to an error; personal details showing as incorrect too.
recommended_action: Avoid asking users to refile tickets; keep troubleshooting in the same thread.

query_text: Same issue reported again: recordings/notes not visible.
recommended_action: Recognize repeat tickets from the same user and escalate automatically rather than repeating the same reply.

query_text: Cannot see competition link, recordings, or notebooks.
recommended_action: Address each item mentioned (competition link) individually instead of a generic template reply.

query_text: The 'Continue' joining bar shows orange instead of green, preventing entry to the course.
recommended_action: Give a more specific opening date/timeframe if available to reduce repeat questions.

query_text: Clicking 'Continue Learning' just refreshes the page instead of opening the course.
recommended_action: Fix recurring bug (also affects ticket #14); correct name spelling; move off personal email addresses.

query_text: Missed the first day of the AI course live session and is asking how to get the recording.
recommended_action: Correct name spelling; consider proactively linking directly to the recording location.

query_text: System shows an error after entering profile details.
recommended_action: Fix the underlying profileupdate bug (recurring across multiple tickets); request screenshots proactively.

query_text: Submitted bank slip for the AI course but status still shows awaiting approval; feels it wasn't received.
recommended_action: Set a clear SLA (e.g., 24 hours) for payment approvals to reduce anxious followups.

query_text: Enrolled via email but can only see dashboard and enrolled courses, not the actual LMS/course content.
recommended_action: Fix copypaste templating so the correct name is always used; avoid stray internal labels like 'Response:' leaking into replies.

query_text: Site keeps showing 'start to learn' instead of modules; the inbrowser compiler shows errors even though the submitted code (printing a welcome message) is correct.
recommended_action: Fix moduleloading and compiler bugs (high priority, blocking task completion); proofread canned responses before sending.

query_text: Cannot get into the LMS at all.
recommended_action: Strictly prohibit requesting user credentials in any support workflow; add this as a policy/training point for the support team.

query_text: Followup on earlier ticket (#3) - still hasn't received access to the Python course.
recommended_action: Proactively communicate course rollout timelines to avoid repeat 'access' complaints (see also tickets #3, #16).

query_text: Cannot get the Zoom link
recommended_action: UNKNOWN

query_text: Notebook viewer shows the Google Drive file tag but the content area below is blank; tried disabling adblockers with no change; suspects a broken link or permission issue. Screenshot attached.
recommended_action: Fix Google Drive sharing permissions on embedded notebooks; acknowledge and reward detailed bug reports to encourage good reporting.

query_text: Unable to join the live Zoom class for the AI course.
recommended_action: For timesensitive liveclass issues, offer immediate direct contact rather than asking the user to troubleshoot alone first.

query_text: Submitted a project proposal but cannot see it confirmed anywhere.
recommended_action: Consider adding a submission confirmation (e.g., onscreen receipt) so students aren't left wondering if it went through.

query_text: Cannot submit the final project even though the submission deadline was extended.
recommended_action: Given proximity to deadline, prioritize immediate resolution; clearly state submission limits upfront in course instructions to prevent this.

query_text: I want to cancel my subscription to the AI course. I no longer have time to continue with my job schedule, and I'd like this processed before my next payment is due.
recommended_action: Confirm cancellation cutoff dates upfront so students know exactly when access ends; set a standard 2448hr SLA for subscription cancellations.

query_text: I'd like to cancel my enrollment in the Robotics course. I signed up last week but realised the schedule clashes with my A/L classes.
recommended_action: State the refundeligible cancellation window in the enrollment confirmation email to avoid repeat questions.

query_text: I've been trying to cancel my subscription myself through the dashboard but there's no option anywhere. Can someone please cancel it for me?
recommended_action: Prioritise building a selfservice 'Cancel Subscription' button in the LMS to reduce manual support load.

query_text: I want to cancel my course subscription and I need written confirmation that I won't be charged again next month.
recommended_action: Autosend a cancellation confirmation email whenever a subscription is cancelled, rather than relying on the agent to remember.

query_text: I need to cancel my subscription for the Python course. Money is tight this month and I can't continue paying for it right now.
recommended_action: Offer a 'pause' option alongside cancellation for students facing temporary financial difficulty.

query_text: I asked for my subscription to be cancelled two weeks ago but I was just charged again this month. Please cancel this properly and refund the extra charge.
recommended_action: Audit why previous cancellation requests aren't being properly closed out in the billing system; add a verification step before marking a cancellation as complete.

query_text: I paid for the AI course but my card was charged twice for the same transaction. Can I get a refund for the duplicate payment?
recommended_action: Investigate payment gateway doublesubmission issue (likely caused by refresh/backbutton during checkout); add a loading state to prevent doubleclicks.

query_text: I uploaded my bank slip for the Robotics course but then accidentally submitted the same slip again by mistake through the wrong form. I only paid once, so please make sure I'm not marked as owing twice.
recommended_action: Add a warning/confirmation step before allowing a second slip upload for the same enrollment to prevent accidental duplicates.

query_text: I was charged twice for the same course within a few minutes of each other. This is a lot of money for me and I need the extra charge refunded urgently.
recommended_action: Create a fasttrack refund process for confirmed duplicate/erroneous charges instead of the standard queue.

query_text: Support told me last week that I wasn't charged twice, but I'm looking at my bank statement right now and there are clearly two identical charges from your company on the same day.
recommended_action: Train support staff to verify duplicatecharge claims against actual bank references before denying them; assign a dedicated followup contact for escalated payment disputes.

query_text: I meant to pay only for the AI course but I think I was charged for both the AI course and the Robotics course by mistake. I only want to be enrolled in the AI course.
recommended_action: Add a clear order summary/confirmation screen before final payment so students can catch mistaken selections before checkout.

query_text: You said my duplicate payment would be refunded but it's been over a week and I haven't seen anything in my account. Can you show me proof it was actually processed?
recommended_action: Set a firm refund SLA (e.g., 7 working days) and proactively notify students if a refund is delayed beyond that, rather than waiting for them to chase it.

query_text: My account has suddenly been blocked and I can't log in at all. I haven't done anything wrong that I know of  can someone please tell me why and unblock it?
recommended_action: Review the autoblock threshold for failed logins  it may be too sensitive  and add an inapp message explaining why an account was blocked instead of a silent lockout.

query_text: My account is blocked and I have an assignment deadline in a few hours. Please unblock it as soon as possible, this is really urgent.
recommended_action: Fasttrack account unblock requests when a student flags an active deadline; consider a priority queue for timesensitive access issues.

query_text: I think my account got blocked because I asked for a refund. Is that really why, and can it be unblocked while the refund is being sorted out?
recommended_action: Clearly separate refundhandling from accountaccess systems so students never suspect one affects the other; fix the recurring falsepositive login block.

query_text: This is the second time my account has been blocked for no reason. It's really inconvenient because I keep missing live sessions while waiting for it to be fixed.
recommended_action: Investigate recurring false account blocks for the same users as a technical bug, not a onetime fix; assign a dedicated contact for repeat cases.

query_text: I got a message saying my account was blocked for 'suspicious activity' but I haven't logged in from anywhere unusual. Is my account safe?
recommended_action: Improve the wording of the 'suspicious activity' block message to reduce unnecessary alarm, and tune the detection sensitivity.

query_text: My account was blocked and now it's fixed, but can someone explain exactly why it happened so it doesn't happen again?
recommended_action: Add a selfexplanatory error message on the login screen itself so students understand block reasons without needing to contact support.

query_text: I signed up for the AI course last week but I've changed my mind  I don't think it's the right fit for me right now. Can I cancel and get a refund?
recommended_action: Clearly display the refund window (e.g., 7 days from enrollment) on the payment confirmation page to set expectations upfront.

query_text: I already watched a couple of the recorded classes but I've decided the Robotics course isn't for me after all. I'd like to cancel and get my money back please.
recommended_action: Publish a clear tiered refund policy (full refund before content access, partial after) so expectations are set from day one.

query_text: I paid for the course this morning but after thinking it over I don't want to continue anymore. I haven't logged into any classes yet  can I get a full refund?
recommended_action: Fasttrack full refunds for sameday cancellations with zero content access, since these are the lowestrisk cases.

query_text: I asked to cancel and get a refund three days ago and haven't heard anything back. I've genuinely changed my mind about doing this course and just want my money back.
recommended_action: Set and enforce a maximum response time for cancellation/refund requests (e.g., 24 hours) to avoid tickets going quiet.

query_text: I want to cancel my enrollment because I've decided to focus on my A/Ls instead, and I'd like a refund if that's possible. I'm not sure how to actually request this though.
recommended_action: Add a simple inapp 'Cancel & Refund' request form so students don't have to guess the process or wait on email replies.

query_text: I want to cancel the course I enrolled in last month. I know I've already attended a few sessions, so I'm not expecting a full refund, but is there anything I can get back?
recommended_action: Provide a simple refund calculator or clear formula (e.g., % of remaining sessions) so students know what to expect before asking.

query_text: I signed up for this course because of the instructor listed on the course page, but I found out the classes are now being taught by someone else. I don't think the new instructor explains things well, so I'd like to cancel and get a refund.
recommended_action: Always notify enrolled students in advance of any instructor changes; treat undisclosed instructor changes as grounds for full refund regardless of usual policy.

query_text: My instructor was changed partway through the course and I really don't enjoy their teaching style compared to before. Before I ask for a refund, is it possible to move to a different batch with the original instructor instead?
recommended_action: Offer batch transfers as a standard alternative to cancellation whenever an instructor change is the root cause of dissatisfaction.

query_text: The instructor teaching my Robotics course right now is honestly not explaining the concepts clearly at all, and I heard this wasn't the instructor originally advertised. I don't want to continue paying for a course I'm not learning anything from  please cancel and refund me.
recommended_action: Set up a feedback loop between student complaints about instructor quality and academic management, not just refunds; verify instructor competency before assigning them to a course.

query_text: I noticed a different instructor has taken over my batch and honestly the new one isn't as good. I'm on the fence about cancelling  what are my options?
recommended_action: Present clear options (transfer vs. refund) proactively whenever a student raises an instructorchange concern, rather than waiting for them to ask.

query_text: I already messaged about wanting to cancel because of the instructor change last week but nobody replied. I still want to cancel and get my refund.
recommended_action: Audit unanswered tickets weekly to catch messages that slipped through; escalate any repeat request automatically to a senior team member.

query_text: I requested a refund two weeks ago and I just got a message saying it was denied, but no reason was given at all. I need to know why so I can figure out what to do next.
recommended_action: Require a mandatory reason field whenever a refund is denied  no refund decision should go out without an explanation attached.

query_text: My refund request shows as 'denied' on my end but I never received any email or message explaining why. This feels really unfair since I don't even know what I did wrong.
recommended_action: Never let a refund status change to 'denied' without an automated explanatory email going out at the same time.

query_text: I was told my refund was denied but nobody explained why, and now nobody is responding to my followup messages either. I want this escalated to someone who can actually explain the decision.
recommended_action: Create a clear escalation path for refund disputes so students aren't stuck when a first response is inadequate.

query_text: I finally found out my refund was denied because I supposedly used the course material, but I only opened one lesson to see if I liked the course, nothing more. I don't think that's fair grounds to deny the whole refund.
recommended_action: Define 'meaningful content access' more precisely in the refund policy (e.g., percentage of course completed) so single previews aren't treated as full usage.

query_text: I only found out my refund was denied because I checked my bank account and saw no refund had come through  nobody told me anything at all. This is really disappointing.
recommended_action: Implement automatic statuschange notifications for every refund case so students are never left to check their bank account for answers.

query_text: I meant to enroll in the Robotics course but I think I accidentally selected the AI course during checkout. Can this be corrected so I'm enrolled in Robotics instead?
recommended_action: Add a confirmation screen showing the exact course name before final checkout to reduce accidental wrongcourse signups.

query_text: I realised a few days into the AI course that I actually wanted to join Robotics  I must have picked the wrong one when I was signing up quickly on my phone. I've only attended one class so far, can I still switch?
recommended_action: Allow easy course switches within the first week with minimal friction, especially when content overlap is minimal.

query_text: I joined the AI course by mistake when I meant to sign up for Robotics, and I'm worried I'll lose my payment if I try to switch now. Can you please help me move to the correct course without having to pay again?
recommended_action: Clarify in the enrollment confirmation email that mistaken signups can be corrected without additional payment, to reduce anxious followups.

query_text: I actually wanted to join the AI course but somehow ended up enrolled in Robotics. I think I clicked the wrong card on the courses page. Could this be fixed?
recommended_action: Improve the visual distinction between course cards on the enrollment page to reduce wrongcourse selections.

query_text: I only just realised today that I've been in the wrong course this whole time  I meant to join Robotics but got the AI course by mistake. I'm worried I've fallen behind now that I need to switch.
recommended_action: Whenever a late courseswitch is approved, automatically bundle all missed recordings/notes with the switch confirmation instead of requiring a separate request.

query_text: I used a discount code at checkout for the AI course but the final amount I paid didn't reflect the discount at all  I was charged the full price. Can this be corrected?
recommended_action: Test the discountcode application logic at checkout for edge cases (e.g., promo period cutoffs, code casesensitivity); refund the difference automatically when a valid code fails to apply.

query_text: There was an offer advertised for 20% off the Robotics course but when I paid, my card was charged the full amount. I'm not sure if I entered the code wrong or if something went wrong on your end.
recommended_action: Log every discount code attempt (successful or failed) so support can quickly verify whether it was a user error or a system issue.

query_text: My friend enrolled in the same AI course yesterday and got the earlybird discount, but when I paid today the discount had already disappeared and I ended up paying more. Can I get the same price as my friend?
recommended_action: Clearly display the offer's exact expiry date and countdown on the payment page so students aren't caught out by timing.

query_text: I specifically waited for the 'back to school' offer to enroll in the Python course and made sure I paid during the offer period, but I was still charged the regular price. This is really disappointing since the whole reason I waited was for the discount.
recommended_action: Crosscheck payment timestamps against active offer windows automatically, and flag mismatches for immediate refund rather than requiring the student to notice and report it.

query_text: I think I may have mistyped the discount code when I paid for the Robotics course, so it didn't apply. I know it might be my mistake, but is there any way to still get the discount applied since I did intend to use it?
recommended_action: Show a clear 'code applied successfully' confirmation message at checkout so students can catch typos before completing payment.

query_text: My video keeps buffering and freezing during every live Zoom session for the AI course, even though my internet works fine for everything else. Is this a problem on your end?
recommended_action: Share a short troubleshooting guide for common Zoom performance issues proactively in the course welcome email.

query_text: I completed the course over a week ago and was told I'd get a certificate, but I still haven't received anything. Can you check on this for me?
recommended_action: Set and communicate a standard certificate turnaround time (e.g., 57 working days postcompletion) to avoid repeat checkins.

query_text: I just received my certificate for the course but my name is spelled incorrectly on it. Can this be corrected and reissued?
recommended_action: Add a nameconfirmation step at enrollment specifically for certificate purposes, since it may differ from casual profile names.

query_text: I can't download any of the PDF notes for the Python course  the download button doesn't do anything when I click it. I need these for offline studying.
recommended_action: Fix the broken download button (likely a permissions or filepath issue); offer a temporary manual workaround while bugs are being fixed.

query_text: I submitted the module quiz for the AI course but my results page just shows a blank loading spinner that never finishes. I don't know if I passed or not.
recommended_action: Fix the quiz results display bug; in the meantime, proactively share scores with affected students rather than making them ask.

query_text: I can log into the LMS fine on my laptop but the mobile app just keeps showing an error message whenever I try to log in from my phone. I mostly want to use the app since it's more convenient.
recommended_action: Investigate recurring mobile app login errors as a pattern rather than isolated reports; ask for device/OS details upfront in the ticket form.
